name: Cell
scope: Complete stories of broad biological interest with mechanism; resource papers need exceptional scale or a new principle.

limits.main_text_counts: under 7,000 words including main figure legends; excludes STAR Methods text, supplemental item legends, references

panel_label.note: capital letters are the Cell rule; 8 pt bold is house style

notes: One file per main figure with all panels; titles and legends stay in the manuscript.
Use only Arial; always embed fonts; flatten to one layer.
Red and green should not be used together.
Scale bar on every microscopy image; plot individual data points with means (recommended).
No generative or AI-assisted creation or alteration of research images, including brightness/contrast/colour balance.
Production rules: at first submission any format, size and resolution is accepted (keep files 1-2 MB).
figure.max_height_note: Cell: each figure must fit one page; recommended maximum 165 x 200 mm

sections: Declaration of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies
front_matter: Highlights (<=4, <=85 characters with spaces, no abbreviations)
eTOC blurb (<=50 words, 2 sentences, third person)
Graphical abstract (required; 1200x1200 px at 300 dpi, Arial 8-12 pt, no data items)

methods.name: STAR Methods
order: Experimental model and study participant details

supplemental.figures: Figure S1... each titled 'related to Figure N'; <=20 recommended; may span pages
supplemental.tables: Table S (Excel when longer than 3 pages)
supplemental.primary_pdf: Document S1: A4/Letter, <=50 MB, Arial 10 pt; no methods (they belong in STAR Methods)

extras: Data and code availability with accession numbers

verified.note: Read on cell.com in a browser (the site refuses automated fetches): figure guidelines, article types, revise-manuscript, final-submission, supplemental information, graphical abstract guide pages 1-2. Not read: STAR Methods author guide PDF (section headings unconfirmed), journal-policies page, final file requirements PDF. Full digest: cell-skills/cell-shared/journal-formats/cell.md.

sources.url: Cell Press graphical abstract guidelines (PDF linked from final-submission)

sources.status: landing page read; author guide PDF not read

skills: cell-skills (Journal Factory's own: cell-figure, cell-writing, cell-statistics, cell-reviewer, cell-response, cell-data, cell-citation, cell-shared)

references.style: numbered superscript; Author, A., and Author, B. (year). Title. Journal vol, pages. DOI.
